selection_rule: Use the smallest family-current standard-library toolchain, keep inherited sealed tools byte-stable, and add family-named route-aware tools only after the x1 freeze.
compatibility_boundary: The v642-v2 evidence-crosscheck tools remain byte-stable and are selected for inherited-source replay only. They are not relabeled as v642-v3 implementation.
global_skill_update_boundary: The current ghc-family-index instructions already express precedence, ownership, safe naming, task-ID privacy, four truth classes, and terminal handoff gating. This phase records the route-specific delta additively rather than rewriting a shared global skill during an active run.
